title: Mitteldeutsche Selbstzeugnisse der Zeit des Dreißigjährigen Krieges (MDSZ)
institution: Thüringer Universitäts- und Landesbibliothek Jena, with Hans Medick and Norbert Winnige (Göttingen)
notes: Electronic edition of four autobiographical texts of the Thirty Years' War, with transcriptions of the originals, digital facsimiles, commentary and indexes: the chronicle of Volkmar Happe (1587-1647/59), the notes of Michael Heubel (1605-1684), Hans Krafft (1589-1665) and Caspar Heinrich Marx (1600-1635). The original address (mdsz.thulb.uni-jena.de) now serves an unrelated Shlink page; the Internet Archive holds copies of the site as it was in 2022. The portal 'Thirty Years War Online' (hosted by the ThULB since 2024) still links to the old address. The counts cover 735 of about 2,600 manuscript pages recovered from Internet Archive copies, so they are a lower bound. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
